articles.summary: Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD), a global leader in transforming the way people bank and shop, today announced that stc pay Bahrain will expand customer access to its digital financial services into physical locations with DN Series® cash recyclers and DN Vynamic® Software . The agreement represents Diebold Nixdorf's first major engagement with a telecommunications-affiliated financial services provider in the Middle East, demonstrating how the company's solutions can support emerging financial-services models beyond traditional banking. The announcement was made at Fintech Forward 2026 in Bahrain. For stc pay Bahrain, the country's innovative and accessible mobile wallet for digital financial transactions and a subsidiary of stc Bahrain, the combination of physical self-service and digital capabilities will provide consumers with greater choice in how, when and where they transact, while supporting the Central Bank of Bahrain's vision for a modern, innovative and cash-optimized society.
articles.title: Diebold Nixdorf Enables stc pay Bahrain to Bridge Digital and Physical Financial Services

articles.summary: Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD), a global leader in transforming the way people bank and shop, today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new share repurchase program whereby the company may repurchase up to $250 million shares of its common stock. The previous $200 million share repurchase program, announced on Nov. 5, 2025, is nearly complete. Tom Timko, executive vice president and chief financial officer, said: "As we reach the completion of our previous $200 million share repurchase program, we continue our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and delivering long-term value to stockholders. The new $250 million program provides additional flexibility to return capital while continuing to invest in and capitalize on strategic opportunities across our businesses." articles.summary: Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD), a global leader in transforming the way people bank and shop, and Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT), a global payments infrastructure company and leader in payments processing and cross-border transactions, today announced their intent to form a global strategic collaboration to develop and deliver integrated ATM outsourcing solutions to financial institutions. The collaboration pairs Diebold Nixdorf's cash recycling ATMs, software and global field services with Euronet's Ren payments processing platform , integrated automated back-office solutions platform and ATM operations expertise. Together, the companies aim to help financial institutions improve efficiency, lower operating costs, simplify ATM management and earn additional revenue by unlocking a broader range of transactions at the ATM, while preserving the flexibility needed to build the operating model that works best for them.
